description: Source code for a Notion folder document loader component in a larger project, implementing the INode interface, with methods to load and process documents from a Notion folder.

classes.name: NotionFolder_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: A class implementing INode to load documents from a Notion folder, with configurable options for text splitting, metadata, and output format.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the NotionFolder_DocumentLoaders with default properties.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Asynchronously loads documents from the specified Notion folder, applies optional text splitting and metadata processing, and returns either documents or concatenated text based on output setting.
